card.name: Digits inside dosing numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point or a digit partway through a number in dose tables, such as the 5 in 2.5 or the point in 10.5 mL. It also fires on section numbers like 2.2.

modes.label: Decimal point or digit in doses
modes.description: A decimal point or digit inside a dose, weight or volume figure in a dosing table.
modes.example: 7 3.5 mL twice daily 10<<.>>5 mL twice daily 8 4

modes.label: Section numbering
modes.description: The digit or point inside a label section number such as 2.5 or (2.2).

card.plain: It marks the middle of a number in a dosing table, where the next digit is still to come.
